subject: School Playground and Bicycle Infrastructure Grants
overview: The committee recommended funding for bicycle infrastructure and approved small grants for new play equipment at various public schools. Members also received a progress update on the McGlynn School inclusive playground and planned upcoming community outreach activities.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Bicycle Infrastructure Enhancements
items.summary: Recommended $20,000 in funding for the installation of modern bike racks and repair kiosks at Medford High School, Andrews Middle School, and the McGlynn Complex. The project aims to encourage cycling and reduce bus reliance as the Clippership Connector opens.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Basketball Hoop
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 small grant for the purchase and installation of a single-rim basketball hoop at the Roberts Elementary School. The project was initiated by fourth-grade students to provide structured play options for older children.

items.title: McGlynn School Gaga Ball Pit
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 small grant for an inclusive gaga ball pit at the McGlynn School. The facility will feature composite boards for durability and an ADA-accessible gate for students using mobility devices.

items.title: McGlynn School Playground Project Update
items.summary: Received a detailed update on the nearly completed $2.8 million inclusive playground, which features extensive native plantings, rain gardens, and specialized equipment designed for visual and physical accessibility. The project is expected to be completed by late August 2024.

items.title: Outreach, Minutes, and Committee Business
items.summary: Planned outreach tabling for Circle the Square and the Farmers Market, approved the minutes of the May 14, 2024 meeting, and discussed filling committee vacancies following a member resignation.
